facts: Question: The ball hits a fielder's helmet lying on the ground behind the wicketkeeper. What happens?
Option A: Dead ball, no runs
Option B: 5 penalty runs to the batting side
Option C: Batter can be caught off the rebound
Option D: Umpire awards a no ball
Explanation: 5 penalty runs are awarded to the batting side, as well as any runs already completed.

captions.facebook: Yesterday's Umpire's Call answer is in! 🏏 When the ball hits a fielder's helmet lying on the ground behind the wicketkeeper, the correct answer is B: 5 penalty runs to the batting side, on top of any runs already completed. That's Law 28.3, so well done if you got it right, and if you didn't, now you know for next Saturday! 🦁
